headline: Terminator fix for merged dialog
summary: A targeted bug-fix release. Many dialog entries were missing page-terminators (§), causing adjacent screens to bleed into each other and overflow. The fix re-emits each affected entry with explicit §-terminators preserved. Most rows below show the same text on each side with only the trailing § added — that's the fix.

msgFileEdits.description: Every msg/onemsg .ofs sub-entry whose text differs between v2.0 and v2.1. Includes new translations (where the previous version still had Japanese or no English) and rewrites (where the English text was changed). Tags like [NPC:1009], [PLAYER_NAME], ▼ (line break), and § (page break) are wire-format control codes — they're shown verbatim, the diff just surfaces the surrounding text changes.
